quote.text: Leads don't close themselves. When the product is the same, speed to follow-up is the whole game.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls on the books — check GHL/Calendly for new bookings before noon, and book the HighLevel onboarding call.
focus: Capital One sent a fresh overnight alert (12:22 AM): "Your payment wasn't completed." Log into Capital One and confirm the failed transaction isn't the card funding your $35/day FB Ads — a silent decline kills delivery on your only live lead channel and you won't get a second warning. If it's the ad card, swap the payment method before today's spend tries to run.

Still 0 closed from 27+ leads at a ~$17 CPL — roughly $460 spent on people who never booked. The gap is follow-up, not traffic. Run a personal call-and-text blitz through every unbooked GHL lead today with a direct booking link instead of waiting on the A2P automation that's still stuck in carrier review.

Meghana, your HighLevel Trial Experience Specialist, emailed offering a free setup call to map your first steps. Reply and book that call — getting the 3 follow-up workflows live is what turns the next batch of $17 leads into booked calls instead of dead contacts. Also confirm the 9 AM auto-post hit all 16 groups and ads are still pacing at $35/day.
